mvp.patientPrompt: Sign in with your face, or the username and PIN your doctor gave you.

mvp.disabled: This account is paused. Contact your doctor.
mvp.faceFailed: Face sign-in did not work. Try again or use your PIN.
mvp.newDoctor: New doctor? Create an account with the invite code
mvp.newDoctorPrompt: A doctor account needs the clinic's invite code.
mvp.faceOffer: Sign in next time with your face or fingerprint, no code needed? Your face never leaves your phone.
mvp.qrFailedHelp: It may be used already or expired (24 hours). Ask your doctor for a new one, or sign in with your username and PIN.
mvp.consentWhat: Nuhoud is an exercise program for hand and shoulder rehabilitation after stroke, supervised by your doctor, as part of a research trial.
mvp.consentData: The camera follows your movement on your device; video is never stored or sent. We keep session results (angles, tasks, time) and your pain and tiredness answers.
mvp.consentWho: Only your doctor sees your file. In research results you appear as a code (like P001), without your name.
mvp.consentSafety: If you feel pain during exercise, press the Pain button and everything stops. This program does not replace emergency care.
mvp.consentFree: Taking part is voluntary; you can stop any time without affecting your care.
mvp.consentAgree: I have read this and agree
mvp.consentNotAgree: Don't agree? Talk to your doctor; no session will start.
mvp.faceExplain: Turn it on to sign in with your face or fingerprint instead of a PIN.
mvp.qrHint: Scan with the phone camera to sign in once within 24 hours.
mvp.pinOnce: The PIN is shown only now. Print it or hand it to the patient.
mvp.addPrompt: The patient is linked to you and can play in the clinic and at home right away.
mvp.addedPrompt: Give the patient the card. The PIN will not be shown again.
mvp.screeningTitle: Eligible for the trial (confirm each item)
mvp.screen_stroke: Confirmed stroke, with hand or shoulder weakness
mvp.screen_stable: Medically stable (blood pressure, heart) for light exercise
mvp.screen_vision: Sees the screen clearly (with glasses if needed)
mvp.screen_shoulder: No severe shoulder pain that prevents lifting the arm
mvp.screeningNote: Every item must be confirmed. If one does not apply, the patient is not eligible for now.
mvp.consentSigned: The written consent form is signed by the patient (or guardian)
mvp.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Choose another or leave it empty.
mvp.actionFailed: That did not work. Please try again.
mvp.confirm_deactivate: Pause this patient's account? They cannot sign in until you reactivate it.
mvp.confirm_remove-passkeys: Remove face sign-in from all the patient's devices?
mvp.measuresHint: Your hand-taken measures at baseline, mid-trial and end. They judge the trial, and the goniometer checks the camera's angles.
mvp.noMeasures: No measures yet. Start with baseline.
